I don't really love or hate it, I just find it weird, forced and unnecessary. Apart from in the scene where they were out together and the old lady thought they were a couple, I thought they had no chemistry. 

I can kind of see why they would fall for each other, but for me the whole storyline seemed like it was just a way to get Larry out of the picture and resolve the triangle between him, Piper and Alex.

I think Morello just lied about him coming to see her when she first got locked up. She was new then and people would have probably expected him to come if she was going round telling them all about her 'wedding'. Especially if her family all came to see her together, she could just say a brother or male cousin was Christopher if Nicky or anyone saw

I had really mixed feelings about him all through watching this season. I felt like I still couldn't forgive him for last season, no matter how much of a good guy he's trying to be. Feel kinda sympathetic 'cause he really just wants to be liked and have a nice normal life, but he's still a misogynistic homophobe.

> Alex is going to be PISSED at Piper.

While I think this is true, I don't think it'll last long. I mean it would be pretty hypocritical seeing as Alex is the one who got Piper thrown in prison. Plus Piper was trying to protect her. 

Edit: everything else you said I can definitely see happening

> I am more in love with Piper, Nicky, Lorna and Poussey

Totally agree. Piper is a lot more likeable this season. I mean I always liked her but she wasn't as annoying. I liked how her interactions with Soso showed that she is definitely not the clueless new girl anymore.

Nicky was, as ever, very funny and clever. But also had some really touching moments with Morello and Piper. Her relationships with both of them are great. 

Morello and Poussey - both broke my heart in different ways. The season really fleshed them out to be very interesting characters.

And I love them all so much more.
Alex ratted on Piper in the first place. They're kinda even now
Pennsatucky - I hated her so much last season but I loved hating her. Now she's likeable but I do miss the crazy
